notes: Device is the dLive S3000 control SURFACE (not the MixRack engine, which is a separate rack unit connected via gigaACE). Desktop/console form factor — not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted/0 is not applicable; it sits on a table/riser, dimensions 870x728x413mm, 28kg). Data pulled directly from Allen & Heath's official "S3000 Technical Datasheet" (PDF) and cross-verified against the official "dLive Surface Getting Started Guide" (AP9899 Issue 2, numbered rear/front panel diagrams), both hosted on allen-heath.com. Two "I/O Port" expansion bays (128x128ch each) are option-card slots (DB25-shaped blanking plates, no I/O fitted by default — accepts Dante/MADI/EtherSound/Waves SoundGrid/ACE cards) and were omitted from the port list since they carry no fixed connector out of the box. AES3 digital I/O is physically XLR3 hardware but is tagged as connector "aes3" to reflect its digital-audio designation on the panel (labeled "Digital In"/"Digital Out", AES 9/10, 11/12, 13/14). gigaACE and DX links use etherCON housings over RJ45 pinout; gigaACE runs Gigabit Ethernet (eth-1g) while DX links run Fast Ethernet (eth-100m) per the manual text. USB and VGA ports have no stated version/resolution grade in the source material, so grade was omitted per instructions. No grade applies to BNC Word Clock (not SDI) or XLR analog/AES3 (not in the graded connector families). This is the control surface only; a full "dLive S3000" system also requires a MixRack (e.g. DM48, DM64, CDM32, CDM48, etc.) sold separately, which has its own distinct I/O not included here.
